title: animation_fallbacks
description: Which animation plays when a model has no clip for the one requested: each entry names an animation and the animation it falls back to, followed until the model has a clip of the animation reached. The source defines one table for every model it draws (a WoW client: AnimationData, one per client build), so a tree holds one such document and every model references it; a single model's bundle embeds it inline. Animations are named by the same identity as a clip's `animation` (REFACTOR/ANIMATION.md "Fallbacks").

$schema.description: The schema this document follows, by its `$id`: the last path segment names the file in husk's schema/ directory, and schema_version says which version of it (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "The contract header").

schema_version.description: Version of the schema this document conforms to.

subject.description: The table; it has no identity of its own.

space.description: Units and axes of every value in the document.

definition.description: A table defines nothing beyond its entries.

references.description: Always empty: the table depends on no other document, and its users reference it, not the other way round.

otherwise.description: What an animation without an entry falls back to (WoW: AnimationData row 0, Stand, the column's value for every row not listed). It can have an entry of its own (WoW's Stand does), which a walk follows like any other.

fallbacks.description: One entry per animation whose fallback isn't `otherwise`, ordered by the animation's identity. A chain that comes back to where it started: what the source does is not known.

items.description: One animation and what it falls back to.

id.description: Stable id from the animation's identity (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "Stable ids"), the same in every tree exported from one table.

animation.description: The animation, by the identity and name a clip's `animation` carries: match a clip on the identity, never on the name.

fallback.description: The animation played instead when the model has no clip of `animation`; if it has none of this one either, look this one up in turn.
